title: Keeping Up With Science #4: Renewable Energy & Climate Innovations

teacherNotes.title: Session Goal
teacherNotes.content: Analyze nuclear fusion, solar/wind breakthroughs, carbon capture technology, and personal eco-choices.

elements.content:
1. What clean energy innovation (fusion, EV batteries, green hydrogen) excites you most?
2. Can technology alone solve the climate crisis, or must human consumption habits change?
Debate Scenario: Is nuclear power indispensable for achieving zero-carbon targets?
